```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Tableau de bord du rapport de stage (cours DATAVIZ) — voir README.md
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
for (f in sort(list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))) source(f, encoding = "UTF-8")

choix_entites <- c(setNames(VUE_REGIONALE, "Zone CEMAC (consolidé)"), setNames(PAYS_CEMAC, PAYS_CEMAC))
JS_NAVIGATION <- tags$script(HTML("
  // Ouvre une page du tableau de bord en cliquant son lien de navigation.
  window.allerPage = function(id) {
    id = id.replace('#', '');
    var liens = document.querySelectorAll('.navbar a');
    for (var k = 0; k < liens.length; k++) {
      var h = liens[k].getAttribute('href') || '';
      if (h === '#' + id || h === '#section-' + id) { liens[k].click(); return; }
    }
    window.location.hash = id;
  };
  (function enregistrer() {
    if (window.Shiny && Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler) {
      Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('allerPage', function(h) { allerPage(h); });
    } else { setTimeout(enregistrer, 200); }
  })();"))
choix_indicateurs <- lapply(split(IND, factor(IND$secteur, levels = PILIERS)), function(x) setNames(x$id, x$nom))
```

```{r serveur, context="server"}
# --- Accueil : statuts actuels par pays ---------------------------------------
output$statuts_accueil <- renderPlotly({
  g <- grille_statuts()
  n <- as.data.frame(table(entite = g$entite, statut = factor(g$statut, levels = c("Sain", "Vigilance", "Alerte", "n.d."))))
  n$entite <- factor(n$entite, levels = rev(PAYS_CEMAC))
  p <- plot_ly(source = "accueil")
  for (s in c("Sain", "Vigilance", "Alerte")) {
    x <- n[n$statut == s, ]
    p <- add_bars(p, data = x, y = ~entite, x = ~Freq, name = s, orientation = "h", customdata = ~as.character(entite),
                  marker = list(color = COULEURS_STATUT[[s]]), text = ~Freq, textposition = "inside",
                  hovertemplate = paste0("%{y} : %{x} indicateur(s) ", tolower(s), "<extra></extra>"))
  }
  p |> layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0, 16), dtick = 4), yaxis = list(title = ""),
              legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.12), margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 20)) |>
    config_plotly() |> event_register("plotly_click")
})
observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "accueil"), {
  e <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "accueil")$customdata
  if (length(e) && e %in% PAYS_CEMAC) {
    updateSelectInput(session, "ind_entite", selected = e)
    session$sendCustomMessage("allerPage", "#indicateurs")
  }
})

# --- Vue CEMAC -----------------------------------------------------------------
grille_vue <- reactive(grille_statuts(PAYS_CEMAC, fin_annee(input$annee_vue)))
output$carte <- renderPlotly(graphe_carte(grille_vue()) |> event_register("plotly_click"))
output$grille <- renderPlotly(graphe_grille(grille_vue()))
observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "carte"), {
  ev <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "carte")
  e <- if (!is.null(ev$customdata)) ev$customdata else PRISME$pays$nom[match(ev$location, PRISME$pays$iso3)]
  if (length(e) && !is.na(e) && e %in% PAYS_CEMAC) {
    updateSelectInput(session, "ind_entite", selected = e)
    session$sendCustomMessage("allerPage", "#indicateurs")
  }
})

# --- Indicateurs : commentaire IA / PRISME -------------------------------------
output$etat_ia <- renderUI({
  if (ia_disponible()) div(class = "etat-ia ok", icon("robot"), " IA connectée (", ia_config()$modele, ")")
  else div(class = "etat-ia repli", icon("gears"), " Commentaires PRISME (aucune clé IA configurée)")
})
output$commentaire <- renderUI({
  com <- commenter(input$ind_entite, input$ind_id, fin_annee(input$ind_annees[2]))
  div(class = paste("bloc-commentaire", if (com$ia) "ia" else "prisme"),
      p(com$texte),
      div(class = "source-commentaire", icon(if (com$ia) "robot" else "gears"), " ", com$source,
          if (!com$ia && ia_disponible() && nzchar(com$raison)) span(class = "petit", paste0(" — ", com$raison))))
})

# --- Téléchargements ----------------------------------------------------------
fichier_rapport <- function(file) {
  cache <- file.path(tempdir(), "rapport_stage_PRISME.docx")
  if (!file.exists(cache)) withProgress(message = "Construction du rapport Word…", value = 0.5, generer_rapport_complet(cache))
  file.copy(cache, file, overwrite = TRUE)
}
nom_rapport <- function() "Rapport_de_stage_NOUMEN_PRISME.docx"
output$dl_rapport <- downloadHandler(filename = nom_rapport, content = fichier_rapport)
output$dl_rapport_accueil <- downloadHandler(filename = nom_rapport, content = fichier_rapport)

output$dl_fiche <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() sprintf("Fiche_PRISME_%s_%d-%d.docx", gsub("[^A-Za-z]+", "_", iconv(input$f_entite, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")),
                                 input$f_annees[1], input$f_annees[2]),
  content = function(file) {
    validate(need(length(input$f_piliers) >= 1, "Choisir au moins un pilier."))
    withProgress(message = "Génération de la fiche…", value = 0, {
      generer_fiche(file, input$f_entite, PILIERS[PILIERS %in% input$f_piliers], input$f_annees, isTRUE(input$f_ia),
                    progres = function(v, m) setProgress(value = v, detail = m))
    })
  })
```
